audit_objective: Determine whether patient_group=461 or any genuine patient IDs exist
root_cause_of_461: The value '461' was an artifact of string splitting the DICOM UID '1.2.826.0.1.3680043.2.461.<comp8>.<comp9>'. The prefix '1.2.826.0.1.3680043' is the Medical Connections root, and '.2.461' is a constant project/organization identifier. It was identical for all 1,994 repository scans and does NOT represent patient identity.

component_8_analysis.technical_explanation: Component 8 represents study/series-level grouping in Medical Connections DICOM generation. While scans sharing Component 8 are very likely from the same imaging study, we cannot formally prove that different Component 8 values represent different patients, nor can we guarantee that a patient examined on multiple days shares the same Component 8.

public_mendeley_metadata_status.conclusion: Genuine clinical patient IDs are NOT available in the public Mendeley repository. Therefore, data splitting must be described as 'Source-Image & Study-Clustered Split', NOT guaranteed patient-level separation. All duplicate/source-image families must be strictly grouped together to prevent scan-level leakage.
